name: rc-tmux
description: Manage rc-tmux from Claude: a status dashboard with restart, stop and start, and a form for new projects (folder, git and GitHub repo, running Remote Control server).

tools.name: rc_status
tools.description: Show every rc-tmux session in a dashboard

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project with rct new over SSH

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Check on a project being created

hosts.title: Machines
hosts.description: SSH hosts that run rc-tmux, separated by commas. The first is the default. Each needs key-based SSH from this Mac.

prompts.name: rc-status
prompts.description: Show every rc-tmux session and its state
prompts.text: Show my rc-tmux sessions with the rc_status tool.

prompts.name: rc-new
prompts.text: Start a new rc-tmux project: show the new_project_form tool with name ${arguments.name} and repo ${arguments.repo}.

prompts.name: rc-restart
prompts.text: Restart my rc-tmux session ${arguments.name} with rc_restart, then show rc_status.
